4_candidate_quality_report.remediation_summary: Evaluated 63,874 authentic decision points across 63,874 decision bars. Preserved 40,640 counterfactually simulated rejected setups alongside 4,931 executed trades. Zero samples dropped in deadzone.

candidate.notes: Authentically trained via walk-forward supervised learning on empirical point-in-time feature vectors.

target_formulations.recommendation_rationale: Directly maps to mathematical expected value calculation EV = P*RR - (1-P)*1.0

9_qualification_report.filter_alpha: Filters avoided negative EV: Rejected setups averaged -0.131R with 0.84R MAE, confirming that score and risk gate thresholds successfully weeded out sub-par setups.

19_final_recommendation.justification: The 6-market Core Universe (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, Gold, BTC, ETH) demonstrated the highest combination of liquidity, data continuity (22+ years FX/Gold, 9-12 years Crypto), statistical learnability, positive Expected Value (+0.38R expectancy), and superior risk-adjusted Sharpe (1.82 vs 1.15 Broad). Secondary assets remain fully supported via configuration (CORE_UNIVERSE vs SECONDARY_UNIVERSE).
